item.case_name: Mood or music piece, no dialogue
item.title: Quiet After the Rain

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen mood film: a lonely bus stop after rain, late at night. Melancholy but peaceful, with gentle movement. Completely silent, no dialogue or text.

item.tests: Tests whether a short silent film conveys a specified mood through imagery, lighting and movement rather than dialogue or explanatory text.

answer_sheet.Setting and mood: A lonely bus stop after rain at night; melancholy but peaceful.
answer_sheet.Visual style and camera movement: Gentle movement; other visual choices are your call.

must_haves: The delivered video lasts approximately 10 seconds and is landscape 16:9.
A lonely bus stop at night is clearly visible, with wet surfaces or puddles establishing recent rain.
Subdued lighting and unhurried pacing convey a melancholy, peaceful mood rather than suspense or excitement.
There is visible gentle movement, such as rippling reflections or a slow camera move, rather than a static image held for the entire clip.
The video is silent and contains no titles, captions or dialogue.

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen mood film: a lonely bus stop after rain, late at night. Melancholy but peaceful, with gentle movement. Completely silent, no dialogue or text. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**The 10-second version is quoted at 240 credits** using free-plan-compatible **LTX 2.5 at 480p**, in widescreen 16:9, with audio disabled.

**Nothing has been generated or charged.** I’ve only used read-only planning tools; I haven’t verified your available balance.

Cheaper options with the same settings:

| Length | Cost |
|---|---:|
| 10 seconds | 240 credits |
| 5 seconds | 120 credits |
| 3 seconds | 72 credits |

**480p is the smallest supported video resolution on your free plan.** Shortening the clip is the clearest way to reduce this cost. I’d suggest a **5-second version**: an empty shelter, streetlamp reflections on wet pavement, subtle puddle ripples, and a barely moving camera.

The planner redundantly asks this despite your “no text” instruction:
“Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?”

Please confirm **no words**, and choose **10 seconds, 5 seconds, or 3 seconds** before I spend any credits.
dialog.user: No words, and the 5-second version at 120 credits—ok, go ahead with that.

turns.agent:
The account refused the generation because of **insufficient credits**. No video was created, and no generation credits were spent.

The approved 5-second version requires **120 credits**. A 3-second version would cost **72 credits**, but I can’t verify whether your balance covers it. I won’t attempt a shorter version without your approval.
